sloka: हृता मृता वा सीता हि भक्षिता वा तपस्विनी ।न धर्मः त्रायते सीताम् ह्रियमाणाम् महावने ॥३-६४-५२॥
transliteration: hṛtā mṛtā vā sītā hi bhakṣitā vā tapasvinī ।na dharmaḥ trāyate sītām hriyamāṇām mahāvane ॥3-64-52॥

translations.english: O handsome one, those demons can change their form at will and are of dreadful nature. Have they abducted or devoured or killed her in this great forest. Even her righteousness could not protect the helpless Sita.
